title: [Feature Request]: Add client_kwargs Parameter to OllamaEmbedding Class
body:
### Feature Description

The current implementation of the OllamaEmbedding class does not allow users to pass additional keyword arguments to the Client and AsyncClient instances. This limitation restricts the ability to customize client configurations, such as setting headers or authentication tokens. 

To address this, we propose adding a **_client_kwargs_** parameter to the **_init_** method of the OllamaEmbedding class. This change will enable users to pass a dictionary of keyword arguments that will be applied to both the **Client** and **AsyncClient** instances, providing greater flexibility and customization options.

### Reason

Unable to call Ollama API server which is enforced by Auth

### Value of Feature

Make Ollama API calls with Auth token

linked_prs.body:
This is crucial if the ollama server is expecting Auth to be provided

# Description

This PR introduces a new client_kwargs parameter to the OllamaEmbedding class. The client_kwargs parameter allows users to pass additional keyword arguments to both the Client and AsyncClient instances. This enhancement provides greater flexibility and customization when initializing the clients, enabling users to configure headers, authentication, and other settings as needed.  Changes:  
Added **_client_kwargs_** parameter to the ___init___ method of OllamaEmbedding.

Updated the initialization of Client and AsyncClient to include client_kwargs.
## Example Usage:
```python
client_kwargs = {"headers": {"auth": "your_auth_token"}}
embedding = OllamaEmbedding(
    model_name="your_model_name",
    base_url="http://localhost:11434",
    client_kwargs=client_kwargs
)
```
Fixes #18013
